content.name: Priyanka Venkataraman
profile: Data engineer with eight years of experience building batch and streaming pipelines for e-commerce and payments companies in Bengaluru. Holds a Critical Skills Employment Permit for Ireland and is moving to Dublin with family in the coming months.

education.qualification: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
details: First Class with Distinction, CGPA 8.9 out of 10

experience.title: Senior Data Engineer
bullets: Led a team of five building the settlement data platform on Snowflake and dbt, serving finance, risk and regulatory reporting.
Designed the Kafka-based ingestion for transaction events at a peak of forty thousand messages a second.
Reduced the monthly AWS bill for the data platform by 38 percent through storage tiering and job right-sizing.
Ran the on-call rotation for the platform and wrote the incident review template the wider engineering group adopted.

experience.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Built PySpark pipelines on EMR for a marketplace's catalogue and pricing data, orchestrated with Airflow.
Migrated the nightly reporting warehouse from a self-managed Postgres cluster to Redshift.
Mentored two graduate engineers in the team's Python standards and code review process.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Developed and supported ETL jobs in Scala for a US insurance client's claims data.
Rotated through the client's data quality team for six months, writing validation rules against the claims feed.

certifications: AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate (valid until March 2027)
Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark
additional: Critical Skills Employment Permit approved; no sponsorship required
